units.source_text: 和往常一样，母亲阿繁正坐在父亲的桌前抽烟。

en.t: As usual, Mother Ashige was sitting at Father's desk, smoking.

units.source_text: 左手托着腮帮，曲着身子，好像在读或写什么的样子。

en.t: She had her left hand propping up her cheek and her body bent forward, as if she were reading or writing something.

units.source_text: 然而，桌面上却什么也没有。

en.t: Yet there was nothing at all on the desktop.
